headline: Dr Kavindhran Velen: Integrated TB and lung health care must deliver better outcomes without weakening TB programmes
dek: The Union's Chief Scientific Officer set out three essentials for integration at the #UnionConf2026 Spotlight Session on moving from TB to lung health in primary care.
body:
Dr Kavindhran Velen, Chief Scientific Officer of The Union, delivered the opening statement at a Spotlight Session at #UnionConf2026 in Rio de Janeiro, according to a LinkedIn post by the International Union Against Tuberculosis and Lung Disease. The session was titled "From TB to Lung Health: Building Integrated Primary Care Models for Earlier Detection".

Dr Velen said integration "must go beyond expanding services" and must deliver better outcomes for people without compromising the strengths of the TB programme. He identified three essentials: protecting TB programme performance through timely diagnosis and treatment, adequately resourcing primary healthcare to deliver integrated services, and demonstrating tangible benefits for patients.

Dr Velen also said that success should be measured not only by sustained TB outcomes, but also by improved health, better access to care, fewer repeat visits and reduced costs for patients.
key_quote: Integration must go beyond expanding services - it must deliver better outcomes for people without compromising the strengths of the TB programme.

source.author_name: International Union Against Tuberculosis and Lung Disease (The Union)
